title: 2021 NBA playoffs - Wikipedia
snippet: The 2021 NBA playoffs was the postseason tournament of the National Basketball Association 's 2020–21 season. Due to COVID-19 pandemic impacting the NBA for the second consecutive year, the regular season was reduced to 72 games for each team and the start date was moved to May from its usual mid-April.
